module.purpose: Provides the settings view for managing members of another team within the current organization, including member listing, pagination, privacy controls, and invitations.
module.summary: This client-side React module loads a target team and organization members, displays the target team's current members with incremental pagination, exposes organization-admin invitation controls, and supports inviting individual or bulk members. It coordinates React state, tRPC queries and mutations, localization, navigation on query failure, cache invalidation, and team-list revalidation.
module.businessContext: Enterprise organization administrators use this screen to manage membership of subordinate teams. Failures can prevent member discovery, invitations, privacy configuration, and accurate team data.
functions: MembersList (~L34-62): Renders paginated team members and empty-state controls.
TeamMembersCTA (~L68-91): Shows the invitation action for organization administrators.
MembersView (~L93-265): Coordinates team queries, member invitations, and settings display.

io: Displays localized success and error toast notifications.
Updates the invitation modal reference during component mount and clears it during unmount.
network: Queries the current organization, target team, excluded organization members, and paginated team members through tRPC.
Submits team-member invitations through a tRPC mutation.
Invalidates organization, team, and member query caches after successful invitations.
Revalidates the teams list after successful invitations.

edgeCases.inputShape: Invalid or absent route team identifier
edgeCases.behavior: Queries remain disabled because the numeric identifier is NaN, and the content stays unavailable.
Displays a localized no-members-found message and disables the load-more action when no next page exists.

edgeCases.inputShape: Query error loading the target team or members

edgeCases.behavior: Shows a count-based success toast and resets invitation fields.
Shows a success toast containing the invited email or username.
Shows the mutation error message in an error toast.

errorHandling.action: Navigate to the enterprise route using router.replace.
Display error.message through an error toast.

invariants.description: Team and member queries are enabled only when the route team identifier is a valid number.
Successful invitations invalidate related caches and revalidate the teams list before subsequent reads.
The privacy switch and invitation modal render only when a team exists.
Successful invitation submission closes the modal and reports the invitation outcome.

assumptions.description: The route parameters are expected to contain an id identifying the target team.
The invitation response uses usernameOrEmail as either an array for bulk invitations or a scalar for single invitations.
The externally exposed modal reference is expected to be invoked with a boolean visibility value.

ambiguities.question: What authorization behavior is enforced by the server when this page invokes the member-list and invitation procedures?
Does the teams-list revalidation complete synchronously or asynchronously relative to the mutation success callback?

concurrencyModel.notes: React rendering is synchronous, while tRPC queries and invitation mutations complete asynchronously; query results may arrive independently.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A user without organization admin or owner privileges renders the team members call-to-action.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Only organization admins and owners may initiate member invitations.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Loading the other team or its members fails.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Unavailable team data redirects the user to the enterprise page.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The member list has no next page.
moduleContractTests.when: render(<MembersList members={members} team={team} fetchNextPage={fetchNextPage} hasNextPage={hasNextPage} isFetchingNextPage={false} />)
moduleContractTests.then: the load-more button is disabled and displays t("no_more_results")
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pagination controls must accurately reflect cursor exhaustion.

moduleContractTests.when: inviteMemberMutation.mutate({ teamId, language: i18n.language, role: values.role, usernameOrEmail: values.emailOrUsername, creationSource: CreationSource.WEBAPP })
moduleContractTests.then: the invitation modal closes, viewer.teams.get is invalidated, and a success toast is shown
moduleContractTests.rationale: Successful invitations must refresh dependent data and provide user feedback.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The members view is unmounted after registering the invitation modal reference.
